title: rinorea angustifolia subsp. albersii
intro: Rinorea angustifolia subsp. albersii, commonly known as the tropical or Asian variant of the narrow-leaved Rinorea species, is a plant species in the family Violaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Rinorea angustifolia subsp. albersii involve wound healing, immune system modulation, and the inhibition of cancer cell growth due to its bioactive constituents. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
